tools.name: count_tokens
tools.description: Count tokens for text in o200k_base and cl100k_base side by side, plus approximate Claude/Gemini/Llama counts with method notes. OpenAI counts (o200k_base, cl100k_base) are exact for those tokenizers. Claude, Gemini and Llama counts are APPROXIMATE (proxy encoding; real tokenizers differ, often by 1

tools.name: truncate_to_budget
tools.description: Truncate text to max_tokens (keep start or end) for an encoding or model.

tools.name: chunk_text
tools.description: Split text into token-bounded chunks on paragraph/sentence boundaries with character offsets, token counts and optional overlap.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate USD cost per model from text or input_tokens plus output_tokens using a dated price table (prices_as_of 2026-10-27). Estimates, not live billing.
